documents.title: About Ajil Saji
documents.content: Ajil Saji, also known as Aju, is a self-taught software developer from Kottayam, Kerala, India. He is passionate about building modern applications, from mobile applications to full-stack systems. He enjoys turning ideas into practical products and continuously learning new technologies. His interests include artificial intelligence, cloud systems, scalable backend development and software engineering. Outside technology, he enjoys drawing, football and cricket.

documents.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications
documents.content: Ajil completed his Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from BVM Holy Cross College, Cherpunkal, Kerala. His undergraduate education provided a foundation in computer applications, programming and software development. He completed his graduation in 2026.

documents.title: Higher Secondary Education
documents.content: Ajil completed his Plus One and Plus Two higher secondary education at SMV Higher Secondary School (SMV HSS), Poonjar, Kerala.

documents.title: Secondary School Education
documents.content: Ajil completed his 10th standard at SMGHS, Chennadu, Kerala.

documents.title: Tata Consultancy Services - Graduate Trainee
documents.content: After completing his graduation, Ajil was selected by Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) as a Graduate Trainee. He completed a four-month training period in Chennai. During this training journey, he developed his technical knowledge and worked on projects as part of the Ignite training program. His training included software development concepts and technologies such as Java, Python, web development, Angular, AI and machine learning, and DevOps concepts.

documents.title: Ignite Technical Training
documents.content: As part of his training journey at TCS, Ajil participated in the Ignite training program. He learned and practiced technologies and concepts including MERN stack development, Java, Python, Angular, artificial intelligence, machine learning and DevOps. He completed two major projects during this training: SkillSync and Smart Warehouse and Procurement Management System. The training also involved practical software development and project-based learning.

documents.title: SkillCraft Technology - Android Development Internship
documents.content: Ajil completed an Android Development internship with SkillCraft Technology from 1 April 2026 to 30 April 2026. This internship provided exposure to Android application development.

documents.title: Technical Skills and Technologies
documents.content: Ajil has learned and worked with several technologies across software development. Programming languages include Java, Python, JavaScript and Go. Frontend technologies include React, Angular, HTML and CSS. Mobile development technologies include Flutter, Dart and Kotlin. Backend technologies and frameworks include Node.js, Django and FastAPI. Database technologies include MySQL, PostgreSQL and Firebase. His learning areas also include the MERN stack, artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, LLM integration, cloud concepts and DevOps. These technologies represent a combination of project experience and ongoing learning.

documents.title: Career Interests and Goals
documents.content: Ajil is interested in becoming an AI and machine learning engineer, with particular interest in LLM engineering, Agentic AI, AI model integration and MCP-based systems. He is also interested in scalable backend development, cloud systems, full-stack engineering and mobile application development. He continuously works on improving his technical and problem-solving skills to become industry-ready and build useful software products.

documents.title: SkillSync - AI Learning Coach
documents.content: SkillSync was developed as part of the Ignite incubator project. It is designed to help users improve their interview performance. Its Learning Coach analyzes interview feedback, identifies weak areas, extracts improvement topics using AI models, and recommends relevant Udemy courses and personalized learning roadmaps from beginner to advanced levels. The frontend uses React.js and the backend uses Django. Ollama models communicate with MCP servers to enhance the Learning Coach. Ajil contributed as a Frontend Developer. The project was completed as part of the Ignite training journey. A public repository link has not been provided.

documents.title: Smart Warehouse and Procurement Management System
documents.content: The Smart Warehouse and Procurement Management System was developed as part of the Ignite training program. It is a web application designed to organize warehouse and procurement workflows through role-based access. Different users have different responsibilities and can perform the operations assigned to their roles, reducing dependence on multiple spreadsheets and making procurement activities easier to manage. The frontend uses Angular. Ajil worked on this project as part of the Ignite training team.

documents.title: TerraScope App
documents.content: TerraScope is a real-time environmental monitoring, weather insights and safety application. It provides weather information, environmental insights, alerts and anomaly-related features. The mobile application is built using Flutter and integrates APIs and cloud services. Its broader features include weather monitoring, air quality information, farmer recommendations, traveler insights, safety features and daily planning. The project is in active development. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/TerraScope-APP

documents.title: TerraScope Backend
documents.content: The TerraScope Backend is the server-side component of the TerraScope application. It handles weather-related data processing, anomaly detection, API services, database operations and notification-related functionality. The project uses backend technologies and cloud integrations, with Python and API-based services in its implementation. It is in development. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/terrascope-backend

documents.title: VibeMatch
documents.content: VibeMatch is a smart matching platform focused on user profiles, matching experiences and real-time interactions. It is a full-stack application with a frontend and backend. Its development includes user authentication, profile management and real-time communication features. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/VibeMatch

documents.title: VibeMatch Backend
documents.content: The VibeMatch Backend provides server-side functionality for authentication, matching logic and API services. Its repository description lists Node.js, database technologies and REST APIs. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/VibeMatch_backend

documents.title: ClassConnect
documents.content: ClassConnect is a private social platform designed for students. It supports posts, comments, file sharing, feedback and notifications. The application was developed using PHP, MySQL and JavaScript. Ajil lists the project as live. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/Classconnect

documents.title: Workly
documents.content: Workly is a productivity-focused mobile and web application designed around task management and workflow management. The project is currently in progress. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/Workly

documents.title: Sentiment Analyzer
documents.content: Sentiment Analyzer is a natural language processing project that analyzes text and classifies sentiment. Ajil is developing his understanding of text preprocessing, labelled datasets, feature extraction, machine learning model training and evaluation as part of this project. Its technologies include Python and NLP. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/sentiment-analyzer

documents.title: FocusFlow
documents.content: FocusFlow is a productivity application developed using Java. It focuses on task flow and improving personal work efficiency. Ajil lists this project as completed. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/FocusFlow

documents.title: Go Calculator
documents.content: Go Calculator is a modular calculator application built using the Go programming language. It includes a command-line interface version and a desktop user interface powered by Wails. Ajil lists this project as live. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/Go-Calculator

documents.title: Go Task API
documents.content: Go Task API is a task management REST API created as a learning project to understand Go backend development. It supports basic task management operations and explores API development, backend programming and web technologies. Its repository description lists Go, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Ajil lists the project as in development. GitHub repository: https://github.com/ajilaries/go-task-api

documents.title: Certifications and Training Certificates
documents.content: Ajil has shared a certification in Mobile Application Development using Flutter and Kotlin. He has also completed the SkillCraft Technology Android Development internship and received an internship certificate.
